---
title: "MRI Safety"
---

EVD considerations before and during MRI. Click a category to expand it.

```{ojs}
mriData = {
  const { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-app.js");
  const { getFirestore, doc, collection, onSnapshot } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD1FLnIrd86qOsFPLi5y1q_EIU0lhL5gxc",
    authDomain: "evdtoolkit.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "evdtoolkit",
    storageBucket: "evdtoolkit.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "1002374431151",
    appId: "1:1002374431151:web:fe3724bb1f39eb4744af5a"
  };

  const app = getApps().length ? getApp() : initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  return Generators.observe(notify => {
    let overview = "Loading...";
    let steps = [];

    const emit = () => notify({ overview, steps });

    const unsubOverview = onSnapshot(doc(db, "MRISafety", "overview"), snap => {
      overview = snap.data()?.text ?? overview;
      emit();
    });

    const unsubSteps = onSnapshot(collection(db, "MRISafetySteps"), snapshot => {
      steps = snapshot.docs.map(d => d.data());
      emit();
    });

    return () => { unsubOverview(); unsubSteps(); };
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
overviewText = mriData.overview
```

```{ojs}
// Group steps by category, sorted by categoryOrder then step order --
// mirrors MRISafetyViewModel's `group()` function in the app.
groupedSteps = {
  const groups = new Map();
  mriData.steps.forEach(s => {
    const key = s.category ?? "Uncategorized";
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, { categoryOrder: s.categoryOrder ?? 999, steps: [] });
    groups.get(key).steps.push(s);
  });
  return [...groups.entries()]
    .map(([category, { categoryOrder, steps }]) => [category, categoryOrder, steps.sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0))])
    .sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
}
```

```{ojs}
function categoryColor(name) {
  const palette = ["#2c7be5", "#27ae60", "#e67e22", "#8e44ad", "#e74c3c", "#16a2b8", "#d63384", "#6c757d"];
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < name.length; i++) hash = name.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  return palette[Math.abs(hash) % palette.length];
}
```

::: {.callout-note}
**Clinical Overview:** ${overviewText}
:::

```{ojs}
groupedSteps.length === 0
  ? html`<div class="fs-empty">Loading MRI safety steps…</div>`
  : html`<div>
    ${groupedSteps.map(([category, order, steps]) => {
      const color = categoryColor(category);
      return `
        <details class="fs-accordion">
          <summary class="fs-accordion-summary" style="background:${color};">
            <span class="fs-accordion-name">${category}</span>
            <span class="fs-accordion-count">${steps.length}</span>
          </summary>
          <div class="fs-accordion-body">
            <div class="fs-grid" style="margin-top:12px;">
              ${steps.map(s => `
                <div class="fs-card">
                  ${s.imageURL ? `<img class="fs-card-image" src="${s.imageURL}" onerror="this.style.display='none'" />` : ""}
                  <div class="fs-card-body">
                    <h4 class="fs-card-title">${s.title ?? "Untitled step"}</h4>
                    <p class="fs-card-desc">${s.detail ?? ""}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              `).join("")}
            </div>
          </div>
        </details>
      `;
    }).join("")}
  </div>`
```
